diffs.diff: magnetic field (uT): datasheet reading gives 0.0625 per count, the part's model has 0.3638, 0.3638, 0.3398
diffs.evidence: The two numbers describe different data. BMM150 datasheet sec. 4.3.2: the Bosch API 'performs an off-chip temperature compensation and outputs x/y/z magnetic field data in 16 LSB/uT' (short/long int), i.e. 0.0625 uT per count of the API's compensated integer output, not of the raw registers. The model scales raw DATAX/Y/Z register counts (0x42-0x47, 13/13/15-bit) and the driver returns float uT via Bosch's compensation; the datasheet gives 'Magnetic field resolution of ~0.3uT' (Dres,m 0.3 uT) per raw LSB. Applying bmm150.c float compensation to the model's trim registers (dig_xyz1=7053, dig_xy1=29, dig_xy2=-3, dig_x2/y2=26, dig_z1=24747, dig_z2=763, dig_z3=7677, RHALL=6970) gives 0.3638 uT/LSB for X/Y and 0.3398 uT/LSB for Z, matching the model; the sim test passes.
